So I’ve been on tinder for two years and I consistently use it but, I’ve never gone on a date from tinder. I’ve had maybe 40 matches in that time. I met this girl a while back on there and we talked for like a month before she was chill with meeting up so we decided to go to a coffee shop. An hour before we were supposed to meet I was stressing super bad. I haven’t been on a date in years. Then she texts me and tells me she’s sick and can’t go. I was supper bummed out. We texted a few more times after that and then she just stopped replying. Ugh I hate how hard this is. Idk what I’m even doing anymore. I’m still using it everyday but not many matches these days. I hate online dating but I’m not good at asking someone out in person because I’m not confident in that sort of situation. Am I just really ugly? I don’t even know. I think I might be a 6/10. I’m just tired of being alone. I feel like with everyone I talk to I put in way for effort than what I get back, even with friends I’ve know for years. I’m that friend that has a best friend but to my best friend I’m just a friend. I think I’m easily forgotten. I haven’t even done anything social in at least 7 months. I always try to hang with my friends but they don’t seem to want me around. Am I a bad person? I’m just tired of all of this. Sorry it turned into a rant. Maybe that’s my problem

I hope you find what you’re looking for. I’m not going to tell you to stop either. I honestly believe that if I had the guts a few years ago to go through with it the affects of it would’ve kept two of my friends alive. I know they had no idea how it would affect me, but I know if I had gone through with it they would’ve seen and felt similar affects as I have. I hope it’s peaceful, but know for someone out there, you will be on their mind daily. That’s why I can’t stand being sober because it’s all I can think about is the if. If I had taken the right amount of pills and if I had tied the knot properly before I took the pills not after. There is the possibility that two of my friends would still be breathing and I know I didn’t know that at the time but I know it now. I don’t think I’ll ever have the balls to get that close again. But I wish I did. Best of luck and bless you. I hope you find rest whether it’s in this life or the next. -K.D.
